title: Neal's minecraft expanded
description:
This mod make minecraft better by so many vanilla plus mod's.

Thanks to all the mod creators for making such great mods.
body:
This modpack is only avaiable for version 1.20.1 and i am ready to make it for more latest version as time progress.

The main reason to choose 1.20.1 because that is the version of minecraft i play and since this modpack is mine personal modpack which i use so i just decided to make it public so those who are new to modding can get the one of best mods in my oppinion and enjoy.

This mod changes almost everything while keeping the vanilla feel. You are free to customise this modpack however you like.


If you have any idea or suggestion feel free to join my discord and share your thoughts
Discord: [Join here](https://discord.gg/3xArtD4QyF)
